name: bunny-net
description: Manage Bunny.net CDN, DNS and Storage through private Rizonetech MCP services.

interface.longDescription: Inspect CDN zones and traffic, manage standard DNS records, browse storage and preview cache purges or small text-file changes. Changes use expiring, single-use previews and explicit confirmation. Private Ubuntu cloud hosting and Windows desktop support use encrypted credentials without recurring 1Password access. Independently developed by Rizonetech; not an official Bunny.net product.
defaultPrompt: List my Bunny.net CDN, DNS and storage zones with coverage.
Review DNS records for this Bunny.net zone.
Browse this storage zone and preview uploading a text file.
